content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

The architecture behind crypto payment gateways for digital products is a game-changer for creators locked out of conventional platforms. By leveraging decentralized payment systems, you can bypass the traditional gatekeepers that charge exorbitant fees and impose restrictive terms. This matters because it empowers you to sell directly to your audience without third-party interference. With the right infrastructure, you can create a seamless purchasing experience, ensuring your customers receive their digital products instantly while you maximize your earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a crypto payment gateway for digital products combines several key components: hosting platforms, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing. For example, using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages allows for free hosting of your storefront, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle backend processes. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the transaction in over 300 cryptocurrencies, instantly confirming payment on-chain. This entire stack is modular, meaning you own it and can scale it as your business grows.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who sell products like ebooks, courses, templates, and software in regions where conventional payment methods are either unavailable or too costly. By using a sovereign commerce stack, you can establish your brand without dependency on platforms that take large cuts of your sales. This architecture is for serious creators ready to take control of their financial transactions and who want to avoid the high fees and restrictions imposed by traditional payment processors.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, allowing you to keep more of your revenue.
The Components That Make It Work Together

A successful crypto payment gateway relies on various interconnected components. The hosting service provides a platform for your digital storefront, while the backend logic handles order processing and customer interactions. Order storage can be managed through solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring you have access to your sales data. Lastly, NOWPayments facilitates payment processing, allowing you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies without the fees associated with mainstream platforms. Each piece is essential for creating a smooth, efficient transaction process that is entirely under your control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign commerce stack, start by setting up your hosting platform with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access. Finally, connect to NOWPayments for crypto transaction processing. By following these steps, you can create a fully functional digital store that allows you to sell products directly to your audience while maintaining complete ownership of your infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment gateway. This system allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. Platforms like NOWPayments only charge 0.5%, significantly less than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad. By leveraging a sovereign commerce stack, you can retain more of your revenue while enjoying full control over your digital storefront.
You own your entire digital storefront and infrastructure — no dependencies.

If you're looking to sell ebooks and other digital products without being constrained by traditional platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package includes all six blueprints and seven templates you need to create, deploy, and scale your digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to explore your options and learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts using a sovereign commerce stack. By setting up your own website and integrating a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, you can avoid the fees and restrictions imposed by platforms like Gumroad.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This flexibility allows your customers to pay using their preferred currency, enhancing their purchasing experience while minimizing your payment processing costs.
